name: Your Company
tagline: We design houses, interiors and public spaces — from the first sketch to on-site supervision

seo.title: Your Company — architecture and interior design studio in Tashkent
seo.description: Private houses, apartment interiors, restaurants and offices. Concept, construction drawings, visualisation and architect's supervision on site.
seo.answer: Your Company is an architecture practice in Tashkent: a private house design from 120,000 UZS per m², an interior design project from 180,000 UZS per m², on-site supervision from 4,000,000 UZS a month. A concept takes 3–4 weeks, a full set of construction drawings 2–3 months.

listing.description: A website for an architecture practice, interior designer or developer. A concrete sheet with a drafting grid: a building axonometry draws itself line by line, a crosshair with coordinates follows the cursor, a project index with huge numbers and services with dimension lines.

sections.title: Architecture that holds its shape
sections.subtitle: We design private houses, interiors and public spaces. We work out light, ventilation and budget as carefully as the proportions of a facade — and stay with the build down to the last socket.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: Twelve years, forty buildings, not one off the shelf
sections.text: Your Company is a team of nine architects, a structural engineer and a services engineer. We start with the site and the people, not with a picture from the internet: how the sun falls in July, where the neighbour's shadow lies, who will live in these rooms in ten years. Drawings are made in BIM — estimates and schedules come from the same model, so the build holds no surprises. On every project our architect visits the site once a week.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: What we design
sections.intro: Order the full cycle or a single stage — for example, just a concept or just supervision of someone else's project.

items.title: House architecture project
items.text: Sketch, plans, facades, structure and building services, plus the package for a building permit.

items.title: Interior design project
items.text: Layout, visualisations of every room, working drawings, schedule of materials and furniture.

items.title: Commercial interiors
items.text: Restaurants, offices, showrooms: zoning, guest journeys, the brand in space, coordination with contractors.

items.title: Procurement
items.text: We select and order materials, lighting and furniture from trusted suppliers and track delivery dates.

items.title: Site supervision
items.text: An architect on site once a week, a photo report, decisions as the build goes, sign-off of works.

sections.label: Stages
sections.title: From the plot to the keys

items.title: Survey and brief
items.text: We visit the site, take measurements and talk through how you live and the budget.

items.title: Concept
items.text: Two or three layouts and a look: sketches, collages, first 3D views.

items.title: Design
items.text: Working drawings, services and the estimate from a single BIM model.

items.title: Procurement
items.text: Materials, furniture and lighting — with prices and lead times.

items.title: Supervision
items.text: Weekly site visits, quality control, sign-off of works.

items.quote: What amazed us was that the estimate in the drawings almost matched the final cost. The difference was three per cent — and that only because we changed the tiles ourselves.
items.author: Shakhzod and Nigora

items.quote: The restaurant opened on time. The architect came every week and settled things with the contractors on site, not over the phone.
items.author: Bobur A.

items.q: How much does a house design cost?
items.a: An architecture project starts at 120,000 UZS per square metre; the total depends on area and complexity. We give an exact price after visiting the plot and the brief.
A concept takes 3–4 weeks, a full set of construction drawings for a house 2–3 months, an apartment interior project 6–10 weeks.
Yes, across Uzbekistan. Site visits are billed separately at actual travel cost.
Yes, including on someone else's project. First we review the drawings and tell you what needs fixing before construction starts.

items.q: Do you help with the building permit?
items.a: We prepare the design package for the khokimiyat and support the approval process, but the client files the application.
In stages under the contract: 30% before the concept, 40% before construction drawings, 30% on handover of the project.
